description: Avalia um projeto completo e roteia automaticamente para o motor da CVM (se possuir token) ou para o AI Act (se for um agente de IA). Sprint E (2026-05-04): roteamento adicional para audit_ai_governance quando isAgenticAI=true E aiModelConfig.targetAIJurisdiction está em {JAPAN, JP, HIROSHIMA, EU, EU-AIA, KOREA, KR}. Resultado merge: privacy compliance + AI governance scoring no mesmo payload.

agenticConfig.description: Agentic AI governance fields (CAIDP Q3 cross-cutting issue, Apr 2026).

canActOnBehalfOf.description: Acts on behalf of human principals

hasCAIO.description: Chief AI Officer designado (DS-920 mandate Japan)

humanRightsImpact.description: Self-declared human rights impact dimensions (CAIDP UG + UNESCO RAM aligned).

icocCommitment.description: Compromisso público Hiroshima ICOC G7 (11 princípios)

prohibitedUseFlags.description: CAIDP red-line categories (April 2026 UN Global Dialogue submission). Set true if the AI system performs the category. Triggers audit_ai_red_lines pre-check.

targetAIJurisdiction.description: Framework AI governance alvo. Aceita JAPAN/JP/HIROSHIMA/EU-AIA/EU/KOREA/KR e aliases (AIBOG, AISI, ICOC, G7, AIA, etc.).

name: evaluate_project_compliance
